subject: math
description: Define and identify central angles, arcs, chords, secants, and tangents in circle diagrams.
learningObjectives: Define a central angle using the center and two radii
Distinguish minor arcs, major arcs, and semicircles
Identify chords, diameters, secants, and tangents in diagrams
Explain how a tangent differs from a secant
Use correct circle vocabulary in short written descriptions
prerequisites: Recognizing points, line segments, and lines
Knowing that a circle has a center and radius
Reading simple geometric diagrams with labeled points
